review.note: LumberLay publishes a density of 0.97 g/cc and a melting point above 210 C, and the reader files it under PEI, whose density starts at 1270. A polyetherimide does not melt at 210 and does not float; the name says a wood-filled filament and the sheet does not say the polymer. Held as a question.
